journal_lines: Dense jungle. Every trunk laced with vines.
Something large moved through the understory. Held still.
Orchids growing from a wound in the bark.
The trees here do not fall cleanly.
A jungle tree falls into other jungle trees. Sometimes the ones beside it want to come too.
Vines thick as my leg. Cut through three before reaching the trunk.
Air heavy as a wet coat. The work took longer because of it.
A toucan watched from a branch three trees over. Did not move when the tree went.
Heat coming up through the paws from the ground. Even in shade.
Cocoa pods on the trunk like small lanterns. Left them. The vines would want them.
